headline: Crisil Reports 5.9% Profit Rise and Announces Rs 17 Dividend
summary: Crisil posted a 5.9% increase in profit and a 20.2% jump in operating income for the quarter ending September 30, setting an October 29 record date for a Rs 17 dividend.
why: Crisil is a leading analytical company providing ratings and research, acting as a barometer for corporate credit health in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Crisil
impacts.why: Strong operating income growth and steady dividend distributions support positive shareholder returns.
